name: around the world superman hold
source_instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Sweep your arms out to the sides and down toward your hips in a wide arc.
Sweep them back overhead along the same path.
Keep your neck neutral and legs lifted throughout.
Lower down with control after your set.

phases.label: Lift chest, arms and both legs

Anterior pelvic skin remains supported, while modest upper-thoracic extension lifts the chest; neck/head orientation follows the upper trunk.
